concept.title: Release progress
concept.shortdesc: Select a release to see its progress. The counts cover every requirement in the release, the ones it introduces and the ones carried over from earlier releases:

strow.stentry: Requirements in the release, with how many are new in it
Requirements whose review status is approved
Requirements whose V&V rollup is pass or verified-manually
Requirements that are both approved and verified
Requirements whose rollup is fail, shown when there are any

conbody.p: The figures stand beside the release's name, above its burn-up and its requirements. The rollup is the one the V&V page shows, including verification rolled up from child projects. The bar beside each release in the list shows its requirements that pass (green, counting those verified by hand), fail (red) and are blocked (amber); the rest are grey. Below the list, a line says how many requirements no release targets yet. The release whose progress is showing is marked with a blue edge in the list.

On a phone the page opens on the current release's progress: its figures as four tiles, then Failing or blocked, the burn-up and its requirements. The Releases tab beside it holds the list, Add release and each release's controls; choosing a release there opens its progress.
The table lists the release's requirements with their review status, their rollup and the releases they are planned for; (inherited) marks a range that comes from a parent.
